title: Acoustic Helmholtz Resonator Pipe
description: 1D acoustic wave-action intake duct coupled to a Helmholtz side-branch resonator cavity with CFL-stable finite-volume cell discretization between ambient inlet and outlet boundaries.
code:
MODEL: Helmholtz_Acoustic_Resonator
SPEED: 2500.0
LAMBDA: 1.0

COMPONENTS:
  INLET = environment_inlet (P = 101325, T = 298.15)
  DUCT_UP = pipe (D = 0.055, L = 0.60, CELLS = 6)
  NECK = pipe (D = 0.032, L = 0.20, CELLS = 2)
  CAVITY = plenum (VOL = 0.0025, P = 101325, T = 298.15)
  DUCT_DN = pipe (D = 0.055, L = 0.60, CELLS = 6)
  OUTLET = environment_outlet (P = 101325, T = 298.15)

CONNECTIONS:
  INLET.out -> DUCT_UP.in
  DUCT_UP.out -> NECK.in
  NECK.out -> CAVITY.port1
  CAVITY.port2 -> DUCT_DN.in
  DUCT_DN.out -> OUTLET.in

  TAILPIPE = pipe (D = 0.048, L = 0.80, CELLS = 5)
  OUTLET = environment_outlet (P = 101325, T = 298.15)

  CYL1.exhaust -> RUNNER_EXH.in

  MUFFLER.out -> TAILPIPE.in
  TAILPIPE.out -> OUTLET.in
